claim_being_audited: The Actor's claim that the model can be certified for the current release as policy-compliant based on aggregate readiness, rehearsal performance, and documentation/monitoring commitments despite a material food-safety segment weakness.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if the material food safety segment weakness is disclosed in current release documentation or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
General readiness evidence cannot override a missing required disclosure or mitigation predicate.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or release documentation showing the current evaluation results for this release.
Provide the exact disclosure text for the food safety inspection segment weakness in current release documentation.
If disclosure is absent, provide the approved mitigation or reviewed risk-acceptance record covering that weakness.
Provide the authoritative record tying the cited evidence IDs to the current release package, not just prior family approval or contextual guidance.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show an approved mitigation.
The available summary says the food safety inspection slice is 1.4 percentage points below the warning threshold, making it a material current limitation.
The available summary also says the release thread contains only an informal monitoring comment and no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language.
Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general readiness, but they do not satisfy the missing documentation/mitigation predicate for certification.
Prior approval of the same model family is explicitly contextual only and cannot substitute for current-release support.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently supportable under policy on the present record.
That current release documentation already contains the required disclosure of the material segment weakness.
That monitoring commentary in the release thread is sufficient in place of approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance.
That public governance guidance meaningfully closes the specific policy gap in current release documentation.
